direct_qnn.backend_error: Could not create context from binary
direct_qnn.exact_blocker: The physical SM8550 QNN backend cannot create the single shared-resource context containing the complete 37-graph route. Failure occurs before graph retrieval.

memory.interpretation: The Android process materialized approximately the context-blob size. This does not prove successful DSP allocation or explain the backend's generic failure.

required_action: No remaining prepared all-loaded direct-QNN route fits/loads on this physical backend. Any continuation requires a new materially different memory/residency architecture or an explicit protocol decision permitting context streaming; neither is currently authorized.
claim_boundary: Physical compatibility failure only. No graph retrieval/model/HTP execution, output, performance, campaign, or registry result exists.
